_comment: v5: two intents, `engage` and `retreat`. Three stances (push / hold_angle / trade) were measured across three seeds each and landed within 0.2 damage of one another: a five-second fight leaves no room for a stance. `retreat` separates and keeps its shaping term (intent_bonus). The clock is off again — it existed for `push`. Every key is spelled out: --reward-json merges onto RewardConfig defaults.
